name: de Leva 1996 male (adjusted Zatsiorsky-Seluyanov)
source: de Leva P. (1996) J Biomech 29(9):1223-1230, Table 4 (male). Lengths are fractions of the reference stature 1741 mm.
notes: len/mass are fractions of height/mass; com is the fraction of the length from the proximal end (head: from vertex, trunk: from cervicale); r = radii of gyration / length about [sagittal(ML axis), transverse(AP axis), longitudinal]. trunk len null = filled from height minus head and hip joint height. Landmarks are assumptions (not de Leva), see docs/16.
